result.title: IMPACT: Image-Conditioned Motion with Physics-Aware Collision and Trajectory Guidance for Video Generation
result.summary: Visually realistic video generation does not guarantee physically consistent motion. Generated objects may exhibit implausible collision responses or rebounds without energy dissipation, while even physically valid motion predictions may not be faithfully realized during synthesis. We propose \textbf{IMPACT}, a physics-state-driven image-to-video framework that addresses these challenges by coupling explicit dynamics prediction with complementary sparse--dense physical guidance. A learnably calibrated Physics State Generator unifies continuous free-flight dynamics with discrete collision responses, linking impact timing, post-impact velocity, rebound attenuation, and eventual settling within a coherent physical-state sequence. To translate this evolution into effective generative constraints, IMPACT derives sparse trajectories and dense region-level motion priors from the same physical rollout. Sparse trajectories constrain global object displacement, while dense priors guide diffusion sampling to encourage coherent object-region motion and suppress unwanted background changes. Their shared physical basis coordinates global and local motion guidance to reduce prediction--generation mismatch. Experiments on 100 controlled sphere--plane collision scenes spanning different material combinations and visual environments demonstrate improved physical plausibility over representative general-purpose, physics-grounded, and motion-controllable baselines. The project repository is available at https://weiweiwiewei.github.io/impact

AI.brief_summary: 提出 IMPACT 这一物理状态驱动的图生视频框架：用可学习校准的 Physics State Generator 将连续自由飞行与离散碰撞响应统一为物理状态序列，并由同一物理 rollout 导出稀疏轨迹与稠密区域运动先验来引导扩散采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式状态序列＋离散碰撞事件跳变」以及由同一状态派生的稀疏/稠密引导，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的连续演化与事件式更新、以及缓解内部预测与实际生成不一致提供概念参照，能否迁移到任务推理状态尚待核查。
